title: Distributed Market Intelligence & Quant QA System

title: RAG Financial Intelligence
description: Retrieval-augmented generation system for querying SEC filings, earnings calls, and financial reports using natural language.

title: Vol Surface Modeler
description: Real-time implied volatility surface construction and visualization for equity options using stochastic vol models.

title: MLOps Pipeline Framework
description: End-to-end MLOps framework for training, versioning, and deploying financial ML models with full experiment tracking.

title: Portfolio Risk Analyzer
description: Monte Carlo based portfolio risk engine computing VaR, CVaR, and stress test scenarios across multi-asset portfolios.

title: Sentiment Alpha Research
description: NLP-driven sentiment analysis pipeline extracting tradeable signals from financial news, social media, and analyst reports.

title: Time Series Forecaster
description: Deep learning based multivariate time series forecasting system for financial and macroeconomic indicators.

title: Crypto Market Maker
description: Automated market making bot for crypto exchanges implementing inventory management and spread optimization strategies.

title: Factor Model Research
description: Multi-factor equity model research framework implementing Fama-French factors plus custom ML-derived alpha factors.
